text:
nina (release): Proposed schedule: remove SDK/runtime pin for runtime v3.1 -> v3.2 during Sun 01:30 UTC change window. Need canary plan, compatibility notes (SDK 2.8/2.9), and rollback playbook.

omar (eng): +1. Can we unpin per-platform? i.e., hosted first, then dedicated pools. Some dedicated clusters still on older kernel drivers.

tess (sre): staged rollout sounds safer. Hosted eu/us canary first. For dedicated, ops will coordinate with infra leads.

rita (pm): request: enable a 3-step canary (2% -> 10% -> 50%) with manual gates. Call out probable p95 delta on long-sequence models in release notes.

deploy-bot: created CR#202406-UNPIN-1818202025: canary plan=02:00 UTC eu-west-1, steps=2% (30m), 10% (30m), 50% (30m), full on manual approval. hooks=/hook/obs,/hook/eval.

ash (ops): ops checklist: update pinlist, create rollback tag "runtime-v3.1-pinback-1818202025", pre-warm caches for canary, pre-stage failover routes. Reserving on-call 01:00-03:00 UTC.

omar (eng): compatibility note: runtime v3.2 changes scheduling for quantized kernels. SDK 2.9 includes a shim for new negotiation; SDK 2.8 clients may hit minor protocol warning but should continue to work. Recommend keeping SDK 2.8 pinned for 24h on customer-dedicated tenants.

tess (sre): proposed rollback criteria: backend error rate increase >0.4% sustained 5m OR p95 >1100ms for 3 consecutive 1m checks OR memory OOM events on any host. On trigger: stop expansion, tag rollback, run `/ops/sync-pinlist runtime v3.1` and notify infra leads.

rita (pm): add a quality gate: eval-run on smoke prompts (release/quick-check) — if degraded-output-rate >1.5% please hold.

omar (eng): ops run command for canary (example):
```
deploy-bot trigger --cr CR#202406-UNPIN-1818202025 \
  --region eu-west-1 --canary 2% --expand-steps 30m,30m,30m \
  --rollback-tag runtime-v3.1-pinback-1818202025 \
  --hooks /hook/obs,/hook/eval
```

ash (ops): I'll execute the trigger and post 10m/40m/70m heartbeats. tagging @tess and @omar for immediate roll call.

nina (release): draft release-note blurb: "Runtime v3.2 rollout (canary): improved kernel negotiation and quantization stability. Rolling canary in eu-west-1 02:00 UTC; expect minor warmup latency for some long-sequence workloads. Hosted customers will see canary first; dedicated clusters may remain pinned until infra validation completes. No expected downtime."

rita (pm): LGTM. please call out SDK compatibility: "Clients on SDK 2.9 are fully supported. SDK 2.8 will continue to function but upgrade recommended; Dedicated customers may have SDK pin for 24h post-rollout."

omar (eng): added note about SDK 2.8 telemetry: watch for negotiation-warning spikes in logs `sdk.negotiation.warn`.

tess (sre): monitoring dashboard saved: /dashboards/unpin/1818202025. Observables: error-rate, p95 latency, kv-cache miss rate, negotiation-warn rate, mem OOM.

deploy-bot: CR#202406-UNPIN-1818202025 status: queued. Next action: `trigger` by ash at 02:00 UTC.

nina (release): final readiness check scheduled for 22:00 UTC. Paste final release-note blurb there.

ash (ops): One ops caveat: if dedicated infra still shows driver mismatch, we'll hold for that cluster and sync pinlists accordingly. Procedure: `ops/hold-cluster --cluster-id <id> --reason driver-mismatch` then notify release.

omar (eng): If rollback happens, please run `/ops/sync-pinlist runtime v3.1` and bump canary window by 2h before retry. Also attach core dumps for any OOM host to ticket CR#202406-UNPIN-1818202025.

tess (sre): on-call playbook link: /runbooks/runtime-unpin-1818202025.

nina (release): thanks all. I'll post final notes and update the customer-facing release copy after the 22:00 readiness call. :thumbsup:
